import Mathlib.RingTheory.Spectrum.Prime.FreeLocus
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.OrzechProperty
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.SMul

/-!
# Local bases for finite flat modules of constant rank

Finite flat modules need not be finitely presented over an arbitrary ring.
Constant rank supplies the missing local bases: lift a basis at one prime,
spread its generation using the finite cokernel, and test independence at
every prime of that open. This is the finite-flat criterion used for the
twisted divisor pushforward in the Grassmannian construction.

The argument is the constant-rank specialization of Stacks Project,
Tag 00NX, implication (8) to (7).
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Submodule LocalizedModule

namespace Module

variable {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

/-- A spanning family of the prescribed constant rank is a basis of a finite
flat module. Independence can be checked after localization at maximal ideals. -/
theorem linearIndependent_of_finite_flat_constantRank
    [Module.Finite R M] [Flat R M] {d : ℕ}
    (hRank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, rankAtStalk M p = d)
    (v : Fin d → M) (hv : span R (Set.range v) = ⊤) :
    LinearIndependent R v := by
  apply LinearIndependent.of_isLocalized_maximal
    (Rₚ := fun p _ => Localization.AtPrime p)
    (Mₚ := fun p _ => LocalizedModule p.primeCompl M)
    (fun p _ => LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap p.primeCompl M) v
  intro p hp
  haveI : Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (LocalizedModule p.primeCompl M) := free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  have hs : span (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (Set.range (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap p.primeCompl M ∘ v)) = ⊤ := by
    simpa [Set.range_comp] using
      span_eq_top_of_isLocalizedModule (Localization.AtPrime p) p.primeCompl
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap p.primeCompl M) hv
  apply linearIndependent_of_top_le_span_of_card_eq_finrank hs.ge
  simpa [rankAtStalk] using (hRank ⟨p, hp.isPrime⟩).symm

/-- A finite collection generating at a prime generates on some principal
neighbourhood. Finite presentation of the ambient module is unnecessary. -/
theorem exists_span_eq_top_localizedModule_away
    [Module.Finite R M] {ι : Type*} (v : ι → M) (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hv : span (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Set.range (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap p.asIdeal.primeCompl M ∘ v)) = ⊤) :
    ∃ f : R, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      span (Localization.Away f)
        (Set.range (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (.powers f) M ∘ v)) = ⊤ := by
  let P := span R (Set.range v)
  have hP : P.localized p.asIdeal.primeCompl = ⊤ := by
    simpa [P, Submodule.localized, localized'_span, Set.range_comp] using hv
  haveI : Subsingleton (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M ⧸
      P.localized p.asIdeal.primeCompl) := by
    rw [hP]
    infer_instance
  haveI : Subsingleton (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl (M ⧸ P)) :=
    (localizedQuotientEquiv p.asIdeal.primeCompl P).symm.subsingleton
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hzero⟩ :=
    LocalizedModule.exists_subsingleton_away (M := M ⧸ P) p.asIdeal
  letI := hzero
  haveI : Subsingleton (LocalizedModule (.powers f) M ⧸ P.localized (.powers f)) :=
    (localizedQuotientEquiv (.powers f) P).subsingleton
  have hPf : P.localized (.powers f) = ⊤ :=
    Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mp inferInstance
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  simpa [P, Submodule.localized, localized'_span, Set.range_comp] using hPf

/-- A finite flat module of constant rank has a basis of that rank on a
principal neighbourhood of every prime, over an arbitrary commutative ring. -/
theorem exists_free_localizedModule_powers_of_finite_flat_constantRank
    [Module.Finite R M] [Flat R M] {d : ℕ}
    (hRank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, rankAtStalk M p = d)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    ∃ f : R, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      Module.Free (Localization.Away f) (LocalizedModule.Away f M) ∧
      finrank (Localization.Away f) (LocalizedModule.Away f M) = d := by
  classical
  let Rp := Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal
  let Mp := LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M
  let j : M →ₗ[R] Mp := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap p.asIdeal.primeCompl M
  haveI : Module.Free Rp Mp := free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  let b : Basis (Fin d) Rp Mp := finBasisOfFinrankEq Rp Mp (hRank p)
  choose a ha using fun i : Fin d =>
    IsLocalizedModule.surj p.asIdeal.primeCompl j (b i)
  let v : Fin d → M := fun i => (a i).1
  let w : Fin d → Rp := fun i => algebraMap R Rp (a i).2
  have hw : ∀ i, IsUnit (w i) := fun i =>
    IsLocalization.map_units Rp (a i).2
  have hv : j ∘ v = b.isUnitSMul hw := by
    ext i
    rw [Basis.isUnitSMul_apply]
    simpa [v, w, Function.comp_apply, Submonoid.smul_def,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul] using (ha i).symm
  have hspan : span Rp (Set.range (j ∘ v)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hv]
    exact (b.isUnitSMul hw).span_eq
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hgen⟩ := exists_span_eq_top_localizedModule_away v p hspan
  let Rf := Localization.Away f
  let Mf := LocalizedModule.Away f M
  haveI : Nontrivial Rf :=
    (show Rf →+* Rp from IsLocalization.map (M := .powers f)
      (T := p.asIdeal.primeCompl) Rp (RingHom.id R)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr hf)).domain_nontrivial
  have hRankf : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum Rf, rankAtStalk Mf q = d := by
    intro q
    exact (congrFun (rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv
      (LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct (.powers f) M)) q).trans
        ((rankAtStalk_baseChange (R := R) (M := M) q).trans (hRank _))
  let bf : Basis (Fin d) Rf Mf := Basis.mk
    (linearIndependent_of_finite_flat_constantRank hRankf
      (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (.powers f) M ∘ v) hgen) hgen.ge
  exact ⟨f, hf, .of_basis bf, by
    simpa using finrank_eq_card_basis bf⟩

end Module
